info.name: Vitoria AI API
info.description: Postman collection for login, product store, lookup lists, and AI product endpoints in Vitoria.

request.description: Login endpoint. It saves data.token automatically into auth_token for all secured requests.

Admin vendors list.
Filters:
status = vendor status such as pending or active.
business_type = vendor business type.
category_type = agriculture or veterinary.
name = store name or user name search.
email = vendor user email search.
category_id = return vendors linked to one category.
page = pagination page.
The first vendor id is saved automatically into vendor_id.

Admin categories list.
Filters:
type = agriculture or veterinary.
search = category name search.
per_page = 1 to 100.
page = pagination page.
The first category id is saved automatically into category_id.

Admin subcategories list.
Filters:
category_id = return subcategories of one category.
type = agriculture or veterinary by parent category type.
search = subcategory name search.
per_page = 1 to 100.
page = pagination page.
The first subcategory id is saved automatically into subcategory_id.

Vendor allowed categories list.
Filter:
type = agriculture or veterinary.
Use this when you are logged in as vendor and want the categories that vendor can sell under.

Admin products list.
Filters:
per_page = 1 to 50.
vendor_id = filter by vendor.
category_id = filter by category.
subcategory_id = filter by subcategory.
category_type = agriculture or veterinary.
product_type = derived type such as fertilizer, pesticide, seeds, or veterinary_medicine.
status = pending, approved, rejected.
is_active = true or false.
has_discount = true or false.
in_stock = true or false.
search = search in names, description, barcodes, manufacturer, and brand.
The first product id is saved automatically into product_id.

formdata.description: Required for admin store only. Use the vendor id returned from List Vendors. Do not send it in vendor API because vendor is taken from logged in user.
Required. Choose the parent category first. It decides whether product is agriculture or veterinary.
Optional. Use it only when the selected category has subcategories. It must belong to category_id.

request.description: Universal product store endpoint for admin. Use barcodes[] only; there is no single barcode parameter anymore. Product type is not a top level field in store API. For agriculture, send agricultural_detail[agricultural_product_type]. For veterinary, send veterinary_detail fields. Each form-data row has its own description explaining when to use it.
Returns all AI products. Supported filters: per_page, vendor_id, category_id, subcategory_id, category_type, product_type, status, is_active, has_discount, in_stock, search.

Returns only agriculture AI products. category_type is forced to agriculture by this endpoint. Supported filters: per_page, vendor_id, category_id, subcategory_id, product_type, status, is_active, has_discount, in_stock, search.

Returns only veterinary AI products. category_type is forced to veterinary by this endpoint. Supported filters: per_page, vendor_id, category_id, subcategory_id, product_type, status, is_active, has_discount, in_stock, search.
